messages: A form may be attached only where the State Filing shows status Approved for the policy state (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.6; MM-FILINGS-CP-2025 4.1).
A location in flood zone A/AE/V/VE must be scheduled under MM-CP-E101 unless a Flood Exclusion Acknowledgment is signed (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.4).
An endorsement must be approved in at least one state, otherwise it cannot be attached anywhere.
An endorsement must state which coverage(s) it modifies.
Class code 0511 (Fireworks or Explosives Manufacturing) is prohibited (MM-UW-CP-2025 2.3).
Flood is excluded (EXCL-FLD, MM-CP-1030 B.1.g via MM-CP-0010 Section B.1). Check for a restoring endorsement.
Florida policies must include MM-CP-FL-01 Florida Amendatory Endorsement (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.2).
MM-CP-E310 is mandatory for locations in FL Tier 1 coastal counties (FL-T03) and TX-T01 (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.3).
Underwriter must not bind a risk above his or her authority level (MM-UW-CP-2025 3.1).
